description: This file defines the 'toMatchText' matcher function used in Playwright testing framework for comparing text content in web page locators or pages, including handling of string or regex expectations and generating detailed failure messages.

methods.name: toMatchText
methods.description: Asynchronous function that checks if the text content of a Locator or Page matches the expected string or RegExp, with detailed error reporting and support for options like timeout and substring matching.
